description: Three numerically hard cores are stubbed out of a Python telemetry toolkit: a Kahan-Babuska-Neumaier compensated sum that must be order-independent and exact on catastrophically cancelling input while classifying NaN and infinities by inspection, Welford/Chan streaming moments with an associative parallel merge that survives 1e9-shifted samples where the sum-of-squares formula collapses, and exact-rational quantiles with five interpolation rules plus a weighted variant that must stay monotone in p.
